description: This file implements an iterator class for handling Server-Sent Events (SSE) streams from the AgentCore component of Bedrock. It supports both synchronous and asynchronous streaming, parsing event lines, and converting them into structured ModelResponse objects. It handles content deltas, metadata, usage data, and stream completion signals.

classes.name: AgentCoreSSEStreamIterator
classes.description: An iterator class for handling Server-Sent Events (SSE) streaming responses from the AgentCore component. Supports both synchronous and asynchronous iteration, parsing SSE data lines into structured responses, and managing stream lifecycle.

methods.name: __init__(self, response: httpx.Response, model: str)
methods.description: Initializes the SSE stream iterator with the HTTP response and model identifier.

methods.name: __iter__(self)
methods.description: Initializes synchronous iteration by creating a line iterator from the response, lazily on first access.

methods.name: __aiter__(self)
methods.description: Initializes asynchronous iteration by creating an async line iterator from the response, lazily on first access.

methods.name: Optional[ModelResponse] _parse_sse_line(self, line: str)
methods.description: Parses a single SSE line of data, extracting content delta, usage info, or final message, and returns a ModelResponse object if applicable.

methods.name: ModelResponse _create_final_chunk(self)
methods.description: Creates a final ModelResponse chunk to mark the end of the stream.

methods.name: ModelResponse __next__(self)
methods.description: Performs a synchronous iteration step, reading lines, parsing SSE data, and yielding ModelResponse objects until the stream ends.

methods.name: ModelResponse __anext__(self)
methods.description: Performs an asynchronous iteration step, reading lines asynchronously, parsing SSE data, and yielding ModelResponse objects until the stream ends.
